comparison.objective: Calibrate a robot tool center point by touching one reference point from four sufficiently different orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Submillimetre tip placement, contact-force control, wrist reorientation, and stable one-second holds.
comparison.success_condition: Four credited contacts: 10–35 degrees from vertical, mutually separated by at least 15 degrees, with tight tip, axis, mount, and hold tolerances.
comparison.reason: Both concern robot commissioning, but the tested abilities differ: multi-orientation point registration versus mechanical damper adjustment, hex-key locking, and validation of dynamic stops.
